decisions.reason: A complete message-539 MODIFY already limits owner discovery to NFTs from the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract NFTs.
A complete message-539 MODIFY already limits ownership and mint reporting to the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract NFTs.
A complete message-539 MODIFY already records that only NFTs from the active replacement contract grant book access.
A complete message-539 MODIFY already limits active-system metadata to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy metadata.
A complete message-539 MODIFY already limits platform statistics to replacement-contract activity, excludes legacy activity, and records the fresh prize-draw state.
A complete message-539 MODIFY already scopes USDC wallet mints to the active replacement contract.
The existing message-539 INTRODUCE directly records the accepted fresh-state migration policy and exclusion of old-contract NFTs; no additional propagated MODIFY is needed.
Replacing the NFT contract and excluding legacy NFTs does not change the requirement to deploy on Base.
Because legacy-contract NFTs will not be used by the active systems, transfer-linked access, referral, badge, and ticket semantics must be limited to replacement-contract NFTs.
